name: Vinestrike
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 1, ranger 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a part or seed of a thorned plant)

EFFECT

Range 30 ft.
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

You transmute a bit of thorned plant matter into a long thorned whip. You make a standard melee attack roll at one creature within range.

This attack roll may be affected by Weapon Finesse if applicable. On a hit, you deal 1d6 piercing damage to the target and attempt to pull it toward you. You make a reposition combat maneuver against the target and add your Wisdom bonus to the attempt. If the check is successful, you may only pull the target toward you.
